documentation.description: Jira Importer Toolkit Configuration File - Complete Reference
quick_start: 1. Copy this file to your project directory
2. Update jira.connection.site_address with your Jira URL (e.g., https://yourcompany.atlassian.net)
3. Set jira.connection.auth.email to your Atlassian account email (or use keyring / env)
4. Set jira.connection.auth.api_token to your API token (get it from: https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens)
5. Set jira.project.key to your Jira project key (e.g., 'PROJ')
6. Update jira.issuetypes and jira.priorities to match your Jira instance

required_settings.jira.project.key: Jira project key (e.g., 'PROJ'). Used when a row has no project key
required_settings.jira.issuetypes: Array of {name, level}. Level 1 = highest (Initiative), Level 4 = lowest (Sub-Task). Names must match Jira
required_settings.jira.priorities: Valid priority names. Must match Jira (case-sensitive). Common: Highest, High, Medium, Low, Lowest

optional_settings.validation.skip_rowtype: If true, rows with RowType='SKIP' are ignored (default: true)
optional_settings.validation.fixers.disabled: Problem codes to disable when --auto-fix is used. [] enables all fixers
optional_settings.validation.priority.number_map: If true, map numeric priorities (1-5) to names during auto-fix (default: true)
optional_settings.validation.estimate.fields: Columns treated as estimates: ['estimate', 'origest'] or a subset
optional_settings.jira.cloud.estimate.multiply_by_60: Legacy Cloud compatibility: multiply estimates by 60 in sinks
optional_settings.jira.custom_fields: Array of {name, id, type}. type: text | number | date | select | any
optional_settings.jira.teams: Array of {name, id} for Team column resolution (JSON equivalent of Excel CfgTeams)
optional_settings.jira.components: Allowed component names for validation (also accepts legacy jira.validation.components)
optional_settings.jira.components_source: Informational only ('jira' | 'compass'). Not read by the app; pipeline is identical either way
optional_settings.app.import.auto_open_page: If true, open Jira page after CSV export (CSV mode)
optional_settings.app.artifacts.delete_enabled: If true, delete temporary artifacts after processing
optional_settings.app.write_processing_meta: If true, write processing metadata back to the Excel file
optional_settings.app.write_report_table: If true, write validation report table back to the Excel file
optional_settings.app.logging.write_to_file: If true, write logs under jira_importer_logs/ (default: true)
optional_settings.app.logging.console_output: If true, show log messages in the console
optional_settings.app.logging.max_log_files: Max rotated log files to keep
optional_settings.app.logging.max_log_size_mb: Max size of each log file in MB
optional_settings.security.use_keyring: If true, resolve/store secrets via OS keyring when available (default: true)
optional_settings.time.h_per_day: Hours per day for estimate parsing (default: 8)
optional_settings.time.wd_per_week: Working days per week for estimate parsing (default: 5)
optional_settings.issueid.prefix: Optional prefix when auto-assigning Issue Id
optional_settings.issueid.width: Zero-pad width when auto-assigning Issue Id

environment_variables.description: Prefer env / keyring over hardcoding secrets

common_examples.custom_priorities: Update jira.priorities to match your Jira instance exactly

important_notes: This documentation section is for reference only — it is not read by the application
Use top-level validation.* for skip/fixer/estimate rules (not app.validation)
app.validation.skip_checks is legacy and is not read by the current app
Issue type and priority names must match your Jira instance
For Excel-based configuration, use the Config sheet and -ce
